name: npc_chumpz-bartender
customDialogue:
Big Chain polishes a glass and grins under his bucket hat.
Welcome to the Banana Bar! First round is on the house.
The band plays when the sun goes down. The chumpz dance until it comes back up.
Try the banana rum. Or don’t. Nobody remembers either way.

name: npc_chumpz-fisher
customDialogue:
Pengu adjusts his goggles. Shh. The big one bites at noon.
The bait shop sells worms and books. Same shelf. Do not mix them up.
Catch a fish, trade it at the bar. That is how we pay around here.

name: npc_chumpz-dealer
customDialogue:
Peely lowers his shades. Roll the bones, friend.
Snake eyes buys the next round. House rules: no peeling bananas at the table.
I wear mine on my head. Keeps the luck in.

name: npc_chumpz-villager
customDialogue:
Banana Band taps the banana in his headband. Emergency snack.
The lagoon is warm, the bar is open, the hammocks are free.
If you see a ripe one on the big sign, tell me. It has been yellow for years.
